source_statement: Release an experimental decision-support tool to a small, monitored group. Preserve the disagreement between the human advocate, safety model, and expert. A credible irreversible harm must trigger an immediate provisional halt. Restart requires affected-party review, expert approval, operator readiness, and independent integrity verification.
purpose: test a bounded release without crossing an irreversible-harm boundary
claim: a controlled pilot may proceed only while the irreversible path remains closed
invariants: credible irreversible harm triggers provisional halt
no single gate may restart the system
authority: human operator authorises only a bounded pilot

dissent.position: release now because people may benefit
do not release while irreversible unknowns remain
release only through a controlled pilot

consequences: credible irreversible harm causes immediate provisional halt
